ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, point $P$ is a point on the bisector $OC$ of $\angle MON$, with $P$ as the vertex, the sides of $\angle APB$ intersect rays $OM$ and $ON$ at points $A$ and $B$, respectively. If $\angle APB$ always satisfies $OA \cdot OB = OP^2$ while rotating around point $P$, we call $\angle APB$ the associated angle of $\angle MON$. If $\angle MON = 50^\circ$ and $\angle APB$ is the associated angle of $\angle MON$, what is the degree measure of $\angle APB$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} \\
Since $OA \cdot OB = OP^{2}$, \\
it follows that $\frac{OB}{OP} = \frac{OP}{OA}$, \\
Since $OP$ bisects $\angle MON$, \\
it follows that $\angle AOP = \angle BOP$, \\
thus, $\triangle AOP \sim \triangle POB$, \\
therefore, $\angle OPA = \angle OBP$, \\
In $\triangle OBP$, $\angle BOP = \frac{1}{2}\angle MON = 25^\circ$, \\
thus, $\angle OBP + \angle OPB = 180^\circ - 25^\circ = 155^\circ$, \\
hence, $\angle OPA + \angle OPB = 155^\circ$, \\
which means $\angle APB = \boxed{155^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: Use an analytic-coordinate setup based on the diagram. Put O at the origin and take the bisector OP as the positive x-axis, with P = (p, 0). Since angle MON = 50 degrees, the two rays OM and ON make angles +25 degrees and -25 degrees with OP. Let A = (a cos25, a sin25) on the upper ray and B = (b cos25, -b sin25) on the lower ray, where a = OA and b = OB. The text condition gives ab = p^2. Compute vectors PA = (a cos25 - p, a sin25) and PB = (b cos25 - p, -b sin25). Use the dot product formula for the angle theta = angle APB. method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中点 O 是角 MON 的顶点，射线 OM 在上方，射线 ON 在下方，OC 位于两射线之间并经过点 P，表示 OP 在角 MON 的角平分线上。点 A 在射线 OM 上，点 B 在射线 ON 上，两条线段 PA、PB 构成以 P 为顶点的角 APB。

再推理：按解析坐标法，令 O 为原点，角平分线 OP 为正 x 轴，设 P=(p,0)。因为 ∠MON=50°，所以两条边 OM、ON 分别与 OP 成 +25° 和 -25°。设 A=(a cos25°, a sin25°)，B=(b cos25°, -b sin25°)，其中 a=OA，b=OB。题设给出 OA·OB=OP²，即 ab=p²。

向量 PA=(a cos25°-p, a sin25°)，PB=(b cos25°-p, -b sin25°)。设 θ=∠APB。点积为
PA·PB=(a cos25°-p)(b cos25°-p)-ab sin²25°
=ab(cos²25°-sin²25°)-p(a+b)cos25°+p²
=ab cos50°-p(a+b)cos25°+p²。
代入 ab=p²，并用 1+cos50°=2cos²25°，得
PA·PB=p²(1+cos50°)-p(a+b)cos25°
=2p²cos²25°-p(a+b)cos25°
=p cos25°(2p cos25°-a-b)。

同时，
|PA|²=a²-2ap cos25°+p²=a²-2ap cos25°+ab=a(a+b-2p cos25°)，
|PB|²=b²-2bp cos25°+p²=b²-2bp cos25°+ab=b(a+b-2p cos25°)。
所以
|PA||PB|=sqrt(ab)(a+b-2p cos25°)=p(a+b-2p cos25°)。
因此
cosθ = [PA·PB]/(|PA||PB|) = -cos25°。
所以 θ=180°-25°=155°。

先描述图像：图中点 O 是角 MON 的顶点，射线 OM 在上方，射线 ON 在下方，OC 位于两射线之间并经过点 P，表示 OP 在角 MON 的角平分线上。点 A 在射线 OM 上，点 B 在射线 ON 上，两条线段 PA、PB 构成以 P 为顶点的角 APB。

再推理：按解析坐标法，令 O 为原点，角平分线 OP 为正 x 轴，设 P=(p,0)。因为 ∠MON=50°，所以两条边 OM、ON 分别与 OP 成 +25° 和 -25°。设 A=(a cos25°, a sin25°)，B=(b cos25°, -b sin25°)，其中 a=OA，b=OB。题设给出 OA·OB=OP²，即 ab=p²。

向量 PA=(a cos25°-p, a sin25°)，PB=(b cos25°-p, -b sin25°)。设 θ=∠APB。点积为
PA·PB=(a cos25°-p)(b cos25°-p)-ab sin²25°
=ab(cos²25°-sin²25°)-p(a+b)cos25°+p²
=ab cos50°-p(a+b)cos25°+p²。
代入 ab=p²，并用 1+cos50°=2cos²25°，得
PA·PB=p²(1+cos50°)-p(a+b)cos25°
=2p²cos²25°-p(a+b)cos25°
=p cos25°(2p cos25°-a-b)。

同时，
|PA|²=a²-2ap cos25°+p²=a²-2ap cos25°+ab=a(a+b-2p cos25°)，
|PB|²=b²-2bp cos25°+p²=b²-2bp cos25°+ab=b(a+b-2p cos25°)。
所以
|PA||PB|=sqrt(ab)(a+b-2p cos25°)=p(a+b-2p cos25°)。
因此
cosθ = [PA·PB]/(|PA||PB|) = -cos25°。
所以 θ=180°-25°=155°。

raw_record.original_question: As shown in the figure, point $P$ is a point on the bisector $OC$ of $\angle MON$, with $P$ as the vertex, the sides of $\angle APB$ intersect rays $OM$ and $ON$ at points $A$ and $B$, respectively. If $\angle APB$ always satisfies $OA \cdot OB = OP^2$ while rotating around point $P$, we call $\angle APB$ the associated angle of $\angle MON$. If $\angle MON = 50^\circ$ and $\angle APB$ is the associated angle of $\angle MON$, what is the degree measure of $\angle APB$?
raw_record.answer:
\textbf{Solution:} \\
Since $OA \cdot OB = OP^{2}$, \\
it follows that $\frac{OB}{OP} = $\frac{OP}{OA}$, \\
Since $OP$ bisects $\angle MON$, \\
it follows that $\angle AOP = \angle BOP$, \\
thus, $\triangle AOP \sim \triangle POB$, \\
therefore, $\angle OPA = \angle OBP$, \\
In $\triangle OBP$, $\angle BOP = \frac{1}{2}\angle MON = 25^\circ$, \\
thus, $\angle OBP + \angle OPB = 180^\circ - 25^\circ = 155^\circ$, \\
hence, $\angle OPA + \angle OPB = 155^\circ$, \\
which means $\angle APB = \boxed{155^\circ}$.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the figure, O is the vertex at the lower left, ray OM is the upper oblique ray, extending toward the upper right; ray ON extends approximately horizontally to the right along the lower side, forming angle MON. OC is the ray from O toward the upper right passing through P, and P lies on OC; A is on ray OM, and B is on ray ON; line segments PA and PB form angle APB with P as the vertex, and in the figure OP lies inside ∠APB.
Reasoning: From the associated angle condition OA·OB = OP^2, we can obtain OA/OP = OP/OB. Because OP lies on the angle bisector OC of angle MON, ∠AOP = ∠BOP. Thus triangle AOP and triangle POB can be determined to be similar by the included angles being equal and the sides including the angles being proportional. Therefore the corresponding angles ∠OPA = ∠OBP. It is known that ∠MON = 50°, so ∠BOP = 50°/2 = 25°. In triangle OBP, ∠OBP + ∠OPB = 180° - 25° = 155°. Also because ∠OPA = ∠OBP, and OP lies inside ∠APB, ∠APB = ∠OPA + ∠OPB = 155°.
